title: Web page: chat + timeline picture against the existing backend

oracle_proposal.note: Medium blast radius: new route + auth surface reuse, but no touch to shared /personal auth or data migration. One critic sub-agent, grounded in real codebase reads (auth.py, sarfgraphmodel.py, schema.py).
oracle_proposal.posted_to_note: NOT posted as a Jira comment this run: team-lead's ground rules restrict Jira writes to reads + one closing comment. Proposal + ratification recorded here and in the committed oracle file instead.
oracle_proposal.proposed_criteria_summary: 17 criteria from the critic, reconciled to 17 ratified criteria (C1-C17) in the oracle file.
oracle_proposal.ratification_note: Ratified by the coordinator (fd360b) under team-lead's explicit pre-authorization to proceed autonomously while Patrick is away, NOT by Patrick's own direct yes on this criteria set. Documented as a deviation in the oracle file and to be flagged in the PR/report.

criteria.text: Page loads on 8889 sandbox; login works; user's own diagram loads.
criteria.evidence: Live 8889 sandbox from this worktree (PYTHONPATH override): GET /companion/ 200 for the auto-auth user with their seeded diagram rendered; unauthenticated request 302s to the training login. Tests assert 200-with-session, 302-without, and that a second user sees only their own (empty) data. Caveat: dev Postgres was down, so the sandbox ran a private SQLite DB seeded with the fixture family - user-scoped isolation is test-proven, but this was not literally Patrick's own diagram 1924.

criteria.text: Chat message returns a coach reply through the existing ask()/Discussion/Statement pipeline.
criteria.evidence: Live sandbox: a real chat message produced a real LLM coach reply (fdserver private prompts loaded) through ask(); the conversation survived a page reload, proving Statement persistence. Tests assert both user and AI Statements persist with correct Subject/Expert speakers and that repeat sends reuse one Discussion bound to the free diagram.

criteria.text: Per-person step line reflects only that person's own directed events, correctly isolated from other people (avoids the known QML mixed-sum bug).
criteria.evidence: build_timeline segments events by person id before accumulating: with interleaved up/down events across two people, person 1's values are 1,2,3 and person 2's are -1,-2 - neither influenced by the other.

criteria.text: auth.py / is_personal_app_request untouched by this unit's diff; existing /personal/* HMAC-only enforcement unchanged.
criteria.evidence: git diff master --stat contains no auth.py (only app.py registration + the speaker-sync extract in personal routes). Behavioral test: a request to /personal/discussions/ carrying a valid session cookie but no FD-Authentication header still gets 401.

criteria.text: New chat-send route rejects a forged cross-origin POST (CSRF).
criteria.evidence: Blueprint before_request calls csrf.protect() on mutating methods. POST with session cookie but no token: 400, no Statement written. POST with a garbage token: 400. POST with the real token from the page: 200.

criteria.text: 3-point line rule: <3 directed points = dots only; 3+ = line bounded to its own point range.
criteria.evidence: 2 directed points: has_line false, zero segments. 3 directed points: segments span exactly first-point date to last-point date, no extension toward now or diagram start. Explicit same events do not count toward the 3.

criteria.text: Certainty rendering: Certain=sharp mark, Approximate=~1yr band, no-date=undated shelf only.
criteria.evidence: Certain points carry band_days=7, Approximate 365; events with no dateTime, and events whose dateCertainty is Unknown, appear only on the shelf and never in any lane. Visually confirmed in the expanded-view screenshot (amber ~1yr bands vs sharp dots).

criteria.text: Gap renders visually distinct from a recorded no-change (same-direction) mark.
criteria.evidence: Segments longer than 730 days carry gap=true (rendered dotted); adjacent segments gap=false (solid); an explicit same event lands in same_marks (rendered as a solid flat dash), not in points. Both treatments visible and distinct in the expanded screenshot.

criteria.text: Strip scale (resting, <=2 lanes) shows only line/dots/amber-? -- no bands/fades/ticks.
criteria.evidence: Server strip payload carries only dot marks, an optional step-line, and question marks - no band/certainty fields (unit test on seed data). Live DOM on the sandbox: #strip contained 0 band rects and 0 dashed paths, 11 dots, 3 amber ? glyphs; bands (14 rects) and gap dashes (8) existed only in the expanded view.

criteria.text: Expanded full view exists: more lanes, labels, bands, undated shelf as chips.
criteria.evidence: Agent-performed manual walkthrough (Patrick away this session): tapping the strip opened the full-screen expanded view with 7 labeled person lanes + 2 pair-bond lanes, amber certainty bands, dotted gaps, bond event stamps with word labels, and the undated shelf as 3 dashed chips. Screenshot doc/workstreams/FD-360/evidence/desktop-2-expanded.png. NOT a substitute for Patrick's own sign-off. REDESIGNED after Patrick's first sandbox walk (DRAWABILITY sparse-data addendum): era-compressed time (linear inside data-density eras, labeled quiet-year bridges between), far-zoom era blocks, drag/pinch/wheel pan-zoom, double-tap era fit, per-mark year labels, question marks attached to their points. Also exercised against a real user record loaded via the lanes loader on the live sandbox (screenshots retained outside the repo per the confidential-data rules).

criteria.text: Tap-a-mark shows a plain one-sentence description, read-only.
criteria.evidence: Agent-performed walkthrough: tapping a dot showed 'Sleep got worse, around 1995, give or take a year.'; tapping a shelf chip showed 'Family never talked about Earl's drinking - no date yet.' No editing UI anywhere. Unit test asserts every point/same-mark/bond-mark/shelf/question carries a non-empty sentence. Screenshot doc/workstreams/FD-360/evidence/desktop-3-bubble.png. Language quality still needs Patrick's judgment.

criteria.text: Lane picker offers exactly the diagram's real people/pair-bonds.
criteria.evidence: Picker chips on the live page were exactly the 7 seeded people plus the 2 pair-bond labels, straight from diagram data; toggling a chip changed the rendered lanes. Endpoint test asserts the people/bond id sets equal the diagram's. UPDATE per Patrick's walkthrough finding: the lane-filter UI was removed by design authority (lanes are coach-chosen defaults + future user pins; a filter panel is a data project). The timeline endpoint still serves the diagram's real people and pair-bonds, and the never-hardcoded rule now applies to the strip default selection (own symptom lane first, busiest household lane second) and the loader's owner derivation.

criteria.text: No silent stale read immediately after an extraction-triggering chat exchange.
criteria.evidence: Timeline response carries an extraction field with four tested states (chat_ahead / extracting / pending_review / current). Live: immediately after a real chat send the page showed 'The picture may be a little behind the conversation.' The picture itself only ever reflects committed diagram state, per the ticket's extraction-stays-as-is scope.

criteria.text: Responsive layout works at mobile (390px) and desktop widths.
criteria.evidence: Agent-performed manual walkthrough (Patrick away this session): re-run against the 8889 sandbox from a freshly reseeded DB, with the walkthrough script reordered so the mobile viewport (390x844) is captured BEFORE any chat message exists in the shared seeded discussion, fixing a prior evidence defect (fd360b flagged that the committed mobile390-1-resting.png did not show the resting state; a peer re-run confirmed the underlying product behavior was correct, but the evidence capture needed to be a genuinely pristine load). Confirmed on the clean re-run: chat input fully on-screen at the bottom (bottom <= innerHeight), strip 348px wide and legible, expanded view usable at both widths; desktop centers a 720px column. Screenshots doc/workstreams/FD-360/evidence/mobile390-1-resting.png, desktop-1-resting.png. Emulated viewport only - no real device/mobile-Safari run this session.

criteria.text: Automated tests exist under btcopilot/btcopilot/tests/personal (or training) covering C1-C9,C12,C13.
criteria.evidence: 25 tests across test_companion.py (routes/auth/CSRF/freshness) and test_companion_timeline.py (drawing math/seed). Full btcopilot suite: 844 passed, 37 skipped, 0 failures.

criteria.text: Seed fixture: 5+ people, 2 couples, 20+ dated events, mixed certainty incl. approximate+undated, exercising every rule above.
criteria.evidence: seed_diagram_data(): 7 people, 2 couples, 26 dated events (certain + approximate) plus 3 undated/unknown, a 3+-directed lane, several <3 lanes, a multi-year gap, an explicit same event, the 1994-move vs 1995-sleep-onset touching pair (order question), and shelf items. python -m btcopilot.companion.seed seeds it for a named user, deleting only diagrams it created itself.

criteria.text: Manual walkthrough per the Manual Testing Protocol on 8889 (snapshot+screenshot+interactions).
criteria.evidence: Agent-performed walkthrough (Patrick away) against the live 8889 sandbox running this worktree's code: page load, DOM snapshot assertions, screenshots at two viewports (mobile captured first, before any chat exists, for a pristine resting state), a real chat send with a real LLM reply, tap-a-mark bubbles, expanded view open/close, lane-picker toggle, zero console errors across the re-run. Deviation: the chrome-devtools/claude-in-chrome browser was not connected (no paired Chrome while Patrick away), so Playwright headless Chromium drove the same URL instead. A peer agent (fd360b) independently re-ran the 25 tests, curl probes, and this walkthrough script and confirmed matching results; it also flagged that the first-committed mobile390-1-resting.png was captured after the shared seeded discussion already had chat history in it (an artifact of the script running desktop's chat send before mobile's screenshot) - the script was reordered and the evidence recaptured pristine. Screenshots under doc/workstreams/FD-360/evidence/. SECOND walkthrough with a real user record loaded via the lanes loader on the live 8889 sandbox: resting strip shows the owner's symptom line with order-question marks over the busiest household lane; mark tap and shelf-chip sentences exercised, zero console errors. Screenshots retained outside the repo per the confidential-data rules.

findings.summary: Personal QML app's own timeline (_calculateCumulative in sarfgraphmodel.py) mixes all people's deltas into one running sum -- not per-person. New page must not reproduce this.
findings.repro: Inspect familydiagram/pkdiagram/personal/sarfgraphmodel.py _calculateCumulative; it keeps 3 scalars summed across every event regardless of person.

findings.summary: btcopilot/auth.py dispatches by URL path prefix; a naive session-auth 'bridge' placed inside the shared authenticator would weaken auth for the live Personal QML app's /personal/* calls.
findings.repro: Read btcopilot/auth.py current_user()/is_personal_app_request()/_authenticate_pro_personal_apps(): HMAC-only, hard 401, no session fallback, chosen purely by request.path prefix.

findings.summary: flask_wtf CSRF is initialized app-wide but the training blueprint's own CSRF hook is currently commented out; a new session-authenticated mutating route needs its own protection or it's a new hole.
findings.repro: Read btcopilot/training/routes/__init__.py _csrf_protect(): body is fully commented out.

findings.summary: Extraction runs async (Celery); a chat reply and the PDP commit it triggers are decoupled in time, so the timeline endpoint can be queried before the delta lands.
findings.repro: Read btcopilot/personal/deepreextract.py and personal/__init__.py init_celery -- extraction is a background task, not inline with the chat reply.

deferred_risk.summary: DRAWABILITY rule 5 (open-ended states fade after last confirmation; death hard-stops a person's lanes) is not implemented - not in the ratified criteria. Expanded view shows no fades and a dead person's lane does not terminate.

Scope call: an event WITH a date but dateCertainty=Unknown is routed to the undated shelf (its date is untrustworthy per 'any date matches'), not drawn as an extra-wide band. Needs Patrick's confirmation.

The live sandbox ran on a private SQLite DB seeded with the fixture family because the dev Postgres on 5432 was down (8888 also not running). C1's 'Patrick's own diagram loads' was verified as 'the logged-in user's own data loads, isolated per user', not against diagram 1924 on the dev DB.

Manual walkthrough used Playwright headless Chromium because no claude-in-chrome browser was paired this session (Patrick away). Same URL, real server, real LLM; but not mobile Safari and not the chrome-devtools MCP named in the protocol.
Cosmetic: two order-question '?' glyphs with near-identical dates overlap at strip scale; bond-lane word labels can collide when two bond events fall within ~a year at narrow widths.

Lane picker lists the Assistant chat person alongside family members (it is in the diagram's people; filtering it out by name would be a hardcoded string comparison). Needs a product call on whether to structurally flag chat-plumbing people.

The manual-walkthrough script (doc/workstreams/FD-360/evidence/walkthrough.py) auto-auths as one fixed sandbox user for both viewport runs, so screenshots share one live discussion; run order now puts the non-mutating mobile check before desktop chat-send so resting screenshots stay pristine, but re-running the script multiple times against the same long-lived sandbox DB will still accumulate chat history into later captures. Not an isolation bug in the product (each real user has their own discussion) - only a caveat for reproducing this evidence.

Era view iteration 2 items, deliberately deferred per evidence-over-completeness: rows with nothing in the visible window still render as empty lanes; repeated per-mark year labels within one year are not deduped; era-detection threshold is a constant (3 years) tuned once against Patrick's record and will need tuning against other records.

Coordinator asked for a specific household as the second default resting lane. The generic never-hardcoded rule (busiest household lane) picks a different household on the real record. Pinning a specific lane needs the planned coach-default/user-pin mechanism; not implementable without hardcoding people today.

Shelf 'ask me about this next time' ships as a chat-input prefill the user sends themselves (honest, zero new persistence). A server-side queued note the coach context picks up automatically is NOT built; logged as the follow-up wiring.

Lane-loader interpretation calls on the scrubbed files: relationship direction mapped to kinds via a small keyword table (cutoff/conflict/distance) with up=Toward fallback after per-doc polarity normalization; entries with a variable but null direction only become 'same' marks when the description says unchanged, otherwise they load as undrawn dated facts; entry-level deaths/weddings within a year of a structure fact are dropped as duplicates. Each is a judgment call on ambiguous source data for Patrick to spot-check against his own record.
